deliverables: Secondary ticket marketplace with on-chain settlement
Custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
Independent third-party security audit with published report and remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public on-chain metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
The proposers commit to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism, with 25% of fees paid until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million plus ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is described as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
Milestone-gated disbursement, unused contingency return, independent oversight, audit reporting, quarterly public reporting, and a TRSC/PSSC framework are presented as treasury protections.
The requested withdrawal is claimed not to breach the applicable 350 million ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Anvil and Sellout are stated to have received no ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 expansion of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, emphasizing enterprise adoption, milestone delivery, audit and oversight controls, adoption targets, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment.
